sitios.nombre: Haughton impact crater, Devon Island, Canada

sitios.notas: Centre (origen: mío) = pixel with the highest mean solar illumination (0.8706) of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 within 9-12 km of the IAU centre of Shackleton; reproduce with python -m pipeline.terreno borde.

IAU centre and diameter (51.8 km); side 70 km = whole crater plus about 9 km beyond the IAU rim circle (origen: mío). The square reaches 106 km from the pole, outside LDEM_875S_5M (75.8 km): LDEM_85S_20M is used.

Centre (origen: mío) = midpoint between the IAU rim circles (IAU centre, IAU diameter / 2) of Shackleton (https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/5450) and de Gerlache (https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/1439), on the straight line joining both centres in the polar stereographic plane (centres 54.2 km apart, rims 27.4 km apart); reproduce with pipeline.terreno.generar.punto_medio_bordes('Shackleton', 'de Gerlache'). Side 40 km (origen: mío) takes in both rims and about 6 km of each crater wall.
